contract.name: Contract
contract.short: A contract is an artifact plus the invariants its consumer is allowed to assume.
must_include: artifact identity (path, key, hash, or schema)
invariants (what must be true for the consumer to proceed)
failure mode (block, retry, or fail) when invariants are not satisfied
notes: Contracts are enforced by deterministic code whenever possible.
When a human gate exists, approval becomes part of the contract state.

contract_layer.name: Contract Layer
contract_layer.short: A contract layer is a phase boundary where one contract is produced and validated before the system can move forward.
properties: has a primary artifact boundary (what is handed off)
has a deterministic validator (preferred) or a human gate
is allowed to block downstream work until its contract is satisfied
owns the meaning of its artifact (its schema and semantics)

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.short: A cycle is one planned operation_key applied to one target file across zero or more retries.
identity: file_path (the target file for the operation)
starts_when: the operator selects the next runnable operation_key from implementation_plan.json
retries: all retries remain inside the same cycle and the same operation_key
retry feedback modifies the next attempt but does not create a new cycle
ends_when: the operation is committed into applied state (success)
the operation is terminally blocked (missing capability, plan blocked, behavior gate blocked, max retries reached, etc.)
gate_interaction: Gate 3 (commit approval) can pause a cycle after verification; that cycle is not complete until the artifact is approved (or auto-approved) and committed.

run.name: Run
run.short: A run is one invocation of node run_ai.js that attempts to apply zero or more cycles against the current compiled plan and state.
artifacts: AI-Human OS/data/workspaces/<workspace_id>/cycle_metrics.jsonl appends one record per completed cycle
notes: A run may have zero cycles (preflight/gate failures).
A run may stop early with a pending human gate (Gate 2 or Gate 3).

complete_run.name: Complete Run
complete_run.short: A complete run is a run that finishes with lifecycle.status=completed and no remaining runnable operations for the compiled plan.
canonical_truth: the operator reached IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE (no remaining operations) during the run
not_complete_when: Gate 2 is not approved (execution never started)
Gate 3 is pending for a verified artifact (commit is blocked)
max cycles or retry policy exhaustion stopped the run
